text: {"assertions":["A missing step bug was identified in the funnel report within analytics/dashboards/funnel.py.","The bug only appeared for payloads larger than approximately two megabytes.","The bug manifested as a stage showing zero users appearing between two populated stages in the funnel.","The root cause was a listener that was registered during execution but never removed.","The fix involved removing the listener during teardown and adding an assertion in a test to prevent regression.","The fix was implemented in PR #4877 on branch fix/missing-step-1.","The bug can be reproduced by building the funnel for a two week window.","After implementing the fix, the error rate decreased from 2.4 percent to under 0.06 percent."]}
